dict.string: Fully Tracked uses the camera to read a nutrition label. The photo is not saved.
Fully Tracked reads activity, heart, body, sleep, vitals, nutrition, hearing, workouts, and mood from Apple Health and stores them on this device.
Fully Tracked can add water, caffeine, nutrition, sleep, and mood you log to Apple Health on this device.
Fully Tracked saves location check-ins, place visits, and significant location changes on this device, including while the app is not on screen. Nothing leaves the device.
Fully Tracked saves a location check-in on this device when you ask, and shows where you are on the map. Visits and significant changes stay on this device too. Nothing leaves the device.
Fully Tracked reads motion on this device to record trips and activity such as walking, cycling, and driving. Nothing leaves the device.
Fully Tracked reads a nutrition label from a photo you choose. The photo is not saved.
